result.idea: exact coarse relational variance calibration (0.50 vs 0.55 on 114-dim geom_rel) in Stage 2I
result.experiment_notes: {"description": "Extends 2pxr1 with a single-factor change in Stage 2I reducing the 114-dim coarse surface-topology relational block scale from 0.55 to 0.50 (0.50 * geom_rel / sqrt(||geom_rel||^2 + 8.0)) so its total variance (0.01034) matches the 63-dim zr79v/e9n7s coarse relational baseline (0.01030) while retaining all 114 [w3, wc3, c23, cc23, 0.5*c34_diag] features.", "insight": "In 58q88, reducing the combined 114-dim coarse relational variance from 0.0213 to 0.01251 improved both early (+0.000114) and ventral (+0.000081) encoding, but left a 21.5% variance overshoot relative to zr79v's 0.0103. Equilibrating the scale to 0.50 tests whether eliminating the remaining coarse variance overshoot further improves early and pooled encoding."}
